verdict.rationale: gstack's own /learn skill lets users review, search, prune, and export what the agent has learned across sessions, and domain skills can be promoted from project to global scope. That gives a thin first-party way to inspect and curate its self-written automations. The ship/VERSION/CHANGELOG workflow versions the user's application code, not the automations, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of skills/automations, documented rollback to prior skill versions, diff-style review of automation changes, and independent corroboration.
